description: LT1 pre-registration (docs/PREREG_trend_lt1.md sec.3) phase-1 collection: BTCUSD/ETHUSD daily OHLCV from the longest available history at each of 3 independent public sources (bitstamp, yahoo, coinbase), kept as 3 separate un-reconciled files per symbol rather than merged, so the trend study (scripts/research_trend_lt1.py) can cross-check sources instead of trusting one.
source: scripts/fetch_daily_lt1.py, three public no-auth REST sources: bitstamp (/api/v2/ohlc/<pair>/?step=86400, paged, BTC/USD from 2011-08), yahoo (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/<SYM>-USD, from 2014-09), coinbase (api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/<SYM>-USD/candles, 300 bars/request, from 2015). A source that is unreachable is logged and skipped, per the pre-registration's instruction, rather than retried indefinitely or backfilled from another source.
retention: permanent dated snapshot, filename-stamped 20260828 (fetch_daily_lt1.py's STAMP constant) -- idempotent, an existing file is not re-fetched without --force.

volume.unit: base currency (BTC or ETH depending on symbol)

known_defects: the three sources per symbol are DELIBERATELY not reconciled/merged into one series -- differing start dates, differing volume conventions, and occasional differing OHLC on the same date (source data quality, not a bug here) are expected; see scripts/research_trend_lt1.py for how it cross-checks rather than picks one

start date differs by source and is NOT the same across bitstamp/yahoo/coinbase for the same symbol (bitstamp 2011-08, yahoo 2014-09, coinbase 2015) -- a source-to-source row-count mismatch on the same symbol is expected, not a partial-fetch failure

coinbase's product ids and yahoo's ticker symbols both assume USD-quoted spot pairs (BTC-USD/ETH-USD); this is Coinbase's retail spot venue, not Coinbase derivatives -- do not conflate with any futures/perp series elsewhere in this repo
